name: Outtake
description:
Outtake finds and removes threats to your brand: impersonation accounts, phishing domains, counterfeit listings, and executive impersonation across social platforms, app stores, domains, and the open web.

Connect this server to bring your Outtake workspace into Claude. Ask what changed this week and get the digest your analysts read, with the alerts behind it. Pull the full analysis payload for a digest when you want to summarize it, chart it, or send it somewhere else. List the entities you protect and check where they're being abused.

You can also act. Submit a suspicious URL for review and enforcement, preview a takedown before filing it, file it, then track delivery and platform confirmations without leaving the conversation.

Access is scoped to a single Outtake profile that you choose when connecting, and to your own permissions on that profile. Requires an Outtake account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Outtake to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Outtake to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.outtake.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Outtake MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outtake lists 15 MCP tools, including get_alert_report_communications, get_digest_feed, get_digest_feed_full, get_digest_instances, get_full_digest_instance, get_full_latest_digest, get_latest_digest, get_manual_report_status, list_collections, list_digests, list_entities, and ping.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Outtake?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Outtake in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
Outtake requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Outtake is developed by Outtake. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
